additional_sources.title: BW Offshore Catcher (UK) Ltd 2024 Environmental Statement
additional_sources.guard: Report states approximately 138,010 tonnes CO2 from 2024 BW Catcher FPSO combustion activities; offshore location blocks parcel promotion.

additional_sources.title: Shell UK 2024 Annual Environmental Statement for Upstream Offshore Operations
additional_sources.guard: Report provides 2024 offshore Scope 1 GHG total and installation/source-stream figure; aggregate/chart evidence is not converted into fabricated installation rows.

additional_sources.title: Repsol Resources UK Limited 2024 Environmental Statement
additional_sources.guard: Report provides 2024 CO2e emissions by installation/source-stream figure and Scope 1 context; exact chart values are not inferred where machine-readable text does not expose them.

additional_sources.title: CNOOC UK Environmental Statement 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official annual environmental statement supports current offshore emissions-method and installation evidence; no numeric row is created without an explicit machine-readable value.

guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CANDIDATE: Reported or monitored source data requires explicit facility, pollutant/gas, quantity, unit, period and method provenance. Offshore measurements remain facility-level and cannot become England cadastral parcel values.
guard_contract.BINDING_CANDIDATE: Permit or facility data supports identity/binding only; no emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SPATIAL_CANDIDATE: Map/grid/boundary data supports spatial matching only; no measured emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SOURCE_UPGRADE: Collection/guidance/aggregate records cannot become parcel GHG without compatible observed quantity and verified parcel geometry.

web_research_basis: Fresh official GOV.UK/OPRED and government-hosted PDF research on 2026-07-27. Direct Environment Agency XLSX download was attempted once and failed; the same binary URL was not retried. Public-statement PDFs yielded explicit machine-readable facility emission values.
